description: You're a freelance consultant who received four contract offers. Read the contract notes from /home/ga/Documents/contract_notes.txt. Create a comparison spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/contract_comparison.xlsx with columns for Client Name, Hourly Rate, Hours per Week, Duration (Weeks), and Total Revenue. Calculate expected revenue using formulas (Rate × Hours × Weeks) for each contract. Save the spreadsheet.
